title: Firms' Response to Credit Supply: Evidence from Upsized Corporate Bond Offerings
authors: Edith Hotchkiss; Hurong Sun; Liying Wang; Yijia Eddie Zhao
eligible_reason: Tables 2-5 are bond-offering-level cross-sectional regressions (upsizing, book size, spread compression on credit-supply measures) with industry/rating/year FE: no panel treatment timing. Tables 6-7 are firm-quarter event windows (-4..+4 quarters) built around each bond issuance (cohort_id), comparing upsized issuers (treatment = upsized_amtw > 0) with non-upsized issuers: every issuer has its own issuance date and post_issue = 1 for all issuers after issuance, so post_issue is an extra treatment regressor alongside post_issue x upsized; the event-window structure is stacked by issuance cohort (absorb(cohort_id year_quarter2) variants); all columns use propensity-score overlap weights from a logit (pweight = overlap_weight) and time-varying firm controls. Violations beyond controls (IPW weights, stacked cohorts, extra treatment regressor), so not a near-miss.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. code_Table 6_7 and APP C6_8.do: logit treatment on pre-issuance firm and market characteristics -> overlap weights; reghdfe y c.q2#c.upsize ... c.q9#c.upsize upsize controls [pweight=overlap_weight], absorb(all_gvkey2n year_quarter2) or absorb(cohort_id year_quarter2); static reghdfe capexw c.post_issue c.post_issue#c.upsize upsize firm_controls [pweight=overlap_weight]. Samples: IG, HY, IG+HY issuers.
data_files_note: README: only 'pseudo datasets (the first 200 observations from each full dataset)' are shipped because of copyright (FISD, Compustat, CIQ, Bloomberg, Refinitiv); full-data Stata logs are included. A non-random 200-row excerpt cannot reproduce the published estimates.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Design ineligible (IPW overlap weights, stacked issuance cohorts, post_issue main effect) and full data withheld.
